# Loop-rotation 244-state candidate

This binary single-tape machine has **244 working states**, including initialization, and one separate halt state. It starts in state0 at head0 on an all-zero two-way infinite tape; every transition moves left or right. The ordinary proof supports **ZFC ⊢ (¬Halt(QT244) ↔ Con(ZFC))**. It saves a different state from the [compensated244 machine](../candidate-compensated244/README.md).

The [exact source rotation](proof/rotation.tex) replaces transfer-then-increment by increment-then-test at the open source address `011`. For arbitrary natural N and X, both terminate after `3X+2` source instructions with N increased by X+1, X cleared and the other seven registers preserved. The surrounding context check covers all8,385 outside edges and excludes outside entry into the loop interior. The actual source has6,459 leaves and8,390 guarded cases.

In inherited labels, delete26 and change only12/0,12/1 and17/1;485 retained rows stay unchanged. The two12 rows exchange targets17/18, and17/1 becomes `0 L 20`. Canonical and inherited labels are different conventions. This is a source-and-decoder transformation, not a claim that arbitrary intermediate binary configurations coincide.

Root's fresh seven-job replay passes exact reconstruction, source context, sparse/dense initialization, frame closure, affine runtime, finite literal fixtures and the complete expanded runtime. The full replay checks **8,390 cases and2,312,438 symbolic rules** in518.026 seconds. It covers487 rows, with only inherited `(27,1)` unused and retained for totality. The unbounded frame permits nine arbitrary primary natural values, gap64+n and every nonempty finite spare suffix of arbitrary values; positive progress and whole-tape endpoints are checked. The finite regression's6,470,964 transitions are corroboration, not the universal proof.

The exact blank prefix is **407,931 transitions**, reaching inherited dispatcher96 with head−5, marker−6, header176, span181, logical seed `(3,0,0,0,3,0,0,0,0)`,167 spare ones and351 one-cells, zero elsewhere. This is the routed245 root frame16 steps later. The startup itself does not establish nonhalting.

At this publication proposal, the exact QT244 consistency endpoint has an ordinary proof and fresh Python certificate replay. A complete new Lean endpoint is pending; existing checked [compensated244](../compensated244_binary.md) and [routed245](../routing245_binary.md) endpoints concern other exact tables. The internal [PA calibration](../pa_internalization.md) is open. Later table/local comparison proofs must be reported with their actual scope. No absolute consistency, unconditional nonhalting, minimality or two-sided independence from consistency alone is claimed.

The subsequent [combined243 candidate](../candidate-combined243/README.md) applies the compensated fold to this rotated table after checking all local invariant and block hypotheses. It is a separate repository development, absent from the incoming ZIP.

The report arrived at `d91a27b462cbf7fdc6537739775fd192b06fb769`, pinned to ProveIt `fd1adfa19f8fe8da41444e3fa43b89a59d891067` and inherited upstream `c132d7eae8158cd3a9850ea3eb7251158c3dd821`. Placement `5513e77ff1` retains the complete source71 delivery through1,007 ancillary files plus37 archive-only members. The [batch167 reconciliation](../../../../../SetTheory/Cardinals/docs/reports/set-theory/zfc-closure-kernels/intake-167.md) preserves its formalism, grammar, joint-source and rejected-NIP research; [recovery/reproduction](../../../../../SetTheory/Cardinals/docs/reports/set-theory/zfc-closure-kernels/intake-167-reproduction.md) restores the original nested package and exact substantive commands. The unused auxiliary whole-frame wrapper's indentation defect remains preserved; the primary expanded command uses a different valid entrypoint.

Credits follow the delivery: Mira-Cult's original calculus/program, Jeff Ketchersid's verification, Andrew James Wade's compiler, ProveIt's preceding reductions, and the incoming concrete rotation and research. The contribution was prepared for Vladimir Reshetnikov's repository; no additional individual author is inferred. Loop rotation and the classical Tarski–Bernays basis are established ideas. Inherited notices and licenses remain attached to the complete intake.
